name: Entity matching quality harness
problem: Match company/person records across messy sources, measure precision/recall, show tradeoffs.
limits: All company/person records and domains are synthetic; no real PII. Labels are retained only for evaluation, not used by the matcher. Candidate pairs deliberately include similar names, changed domains, old cities and near-collision negatives. The fixed threshold is declared rather than optimized on this test set. evidence/precision-recall.svg and evidence/precision-recall.json show the full sweep; evidence/error-analysis.md exposes actual false positives/negatives. This pairwise harness does not claim scalable candidate generation, global entity resolution or calibrated match probabilities.
next: Add independent synthetic distributions, blocking strategies and subgroup-specific error analysis.
